content: Discord's official Widget (enabled in Server Settings > Widget) exposes a client-rendered iframe/JSON showing online members + invite link at no engineering cost beyond an <iframe src='https://discord.com/widget?id=SERVER_ID&theme=dark'> embed. Official widget is read-only (no chat). WidgetBot is the common 3rd-party alternative for an embedded, interactive chat widget (sign-in, view/send messages) but adds a bot dependency and its own script.
